card.name: Start of a drug name or number
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name split into parts (zafirlukast, paclitaxel, hydrocodone, megestrol) after words like between, administering or to. It also fires on the start of a number in a range or decimal.

modes.label: Start of drug name
modes.description: The first letters of a generic drug name that the text then continues spelling out.
modes.example: Caution should be exercised when administering<< pa>>clitaxel concomitantly

modes.label: Number start
modes.description: The empty or leading piece just before the digits in a range or decimal dose.

modes.label: Abbreviation start
modes.description: The first letters of an abbreviation or heading word that is split into pieces.
modes.example: children and adolescents are described in CLINICAL<< PH>>ARMACOLOGY and DOSAGE AND
